findings.title: CVE-2026-84782 in psycopg-binary bundled OpenSSL 3.5.8

normalized_input.claimed_source: Peer-controlled traffic during a suspended DTLS handshake write
normalized_input.claimed_sink: DTLS retransmission reads stale message buffer offset
normalized_input.claimed_control: Retransmission state is not reset or deferred during suspended writes
normalized_input.affected_version_or_path: OpenSSL 3.5.8; installed API wheel per retained linkage evidence
preconditions: Suspended handshake write and overlapping retransmission
normalized_input.impact: Heap disclosure or denial of service

affected_locations.label: dependency
affected_locations.detail: Pins psycopg[binary] 3.3.6 including its native libraries

affected_locations.label: caller
affected_locations.detail: Passes operator-configured PostgreSQL URL to ConnectionPool or psycopg.connect

affected_locations.label: configuration
affected_locations.detail: PostgreSQL DSN comes from environment/config, not a user API input

reachable_path: Operator DSN -> psycopg ConnectionPool/connect -> libpq 18.6 -> OpenSSL TLS stream path
No path from this caller to DTLS retransmission established

boundary_assessment.product_surface: Local API and maintenance worker; native development runtime
boundary_assessment.policy_basis: No applicable SECURITY.md; Settings environment handling, database caller, Compose deployment and retained linkage evidence

exploitability_stack_rank.rationale: Only selected input; affected version exists but required DTLS consumer is unproven.

evidence: Retained 30 October linkage evidence reports bundled OpenSSL 3.5.8 and libpq 180006
Upstream 29 September advisory fixes 3.5 branch in 3.5.9
counterevidence: libpq REL_18_6 fe-secure-openssl.c initialize_SSL uses SSLv23_method/TLS stream context
MarkeTOB has no DTLS API or user-selected OpenSSL protocol context
proof_gaps: All transitive bundled native consumers and platform-specific linkage have not been fully established
Version metadata alone is not an exploitation path
No dynamic validation in this static phase
findings.recommended_next_step: Record native linkage on Linux and Windows; retain scoped TLS counterevidence. No stable psycopg release upgrade currently available. A different packaging strategy requires separate compatibility validation.
